#Start of the PCA: try factoring by season
```{r, making combined_df wide}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

combined_df_wide <- object_counts_og_with_dates_no_detritus %>% # use object_counts_per_m3_by_date for all taxa and object_counts_og_with_dates_no_detritus for top 5
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = object_annotation_category,
    values_from = n_cor_ind_m3,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(Date = object_date)
print(combined_df_wide)
```
#Import and combine data
```{r import and combine dataframes, include=FALSE}
pca_data <- read.csv("pca.csv")
pca_data_df <- as.data.frame(pca_data)
pca_data_df <- pca_data_df %>% mutate(
    Month = month(Date),
    Season = case_when(
      Month %in% 1:3 ~ "Winter",
      Month %in% 4:6 ~ "Spring",
      Month %in% 7:9 ~ "Summer",
      Month %in% 10:12 ~ "Fall"
    )
  )
print(pca_data_df) 
#head(pca_data_df$Date, 10)
pca_data_df$Date <- as.Date(pca_data_df$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
pca_data_df <- pca_data_df %>%
  mutate(Date = update(Date, year = year(Date) + 2000)) %>% 
         filter(Location == "Ram")

pca_df <- left_join(pca_data_df, combined_df_wide, by = c("Date" = "Date"))
#pca_df <- na.omit(pca_df)
# Inspect result
print(pca_df)

pca_df_filtered <- pca_df %>% select(-Location, -Date, -STD, -Salinity_Min, -Salinity_Max, -Water_Temp_Min, -Water_Temp_Max, -sample_net_mesh)

print(pca_df_filtered)
```
#Standardize data
#Hellinger
```{r hellinger, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(vegan)

# Ensure data.table
setDT(pca_df_filtered)

# Identify numeric columns
numeric_cols <- sapply(pca_df_filtered, is.numeric)
numeric_colnames <- names(numeric_cols[numeric_cols])

# Exclude environmental / metadata columns
exclude_cols <- c(
  "Salinity_Avg",
  "Water_Temp_Avg",
  "Secchi.depth",
  "avg_chl_a",
  "Month",
  "Season", 
  "acq_sub_part"
)

# Community columns only
community_cols <- setdiff(numeric_colnames, exclude_cols)

# Subset community matrix
community_df <- pca_df_filtered[, ..community_cols]

# Hellinger transform
community_hellinger <- decostand(
  as.matrix(community_df),
  method = "hellinger"
)

# Check for negative values
any(community_df < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check for NAs
anyNA(community_df)
community_hellinger <- decostand(community_df, method = "hellinger")
print(community_hellinger)

community_hellinger <- as.data.table(community_hellinger)
setnames(community_hellinger, community_cols)

community_hellinger <- cbind(
  pca_df_filtered[, ..exclude_cols],
  community_hellinger
)
print(community_hellinger)

#community_hellinger <- community_hellinger %>%
 # select(-Salinity_Min, -Salinity_Max, -Water_Temp_Min, Water_Temp_Max, -STD, -sample_net_mesh)
```
```{r pca plots NEW, include=FALSE}
# PCA with Hellinger community data + environmental vectors
library(data.table)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(pcaMethods)

library(pcaMethods)
# Ensure data.table
setDT(community_hellinger)

# 1. Split data into roles
# Environmental variables (for envfit vectors)
env_df <- as.data.frame(
  community_hellinger[, ..exclude_cols] # looks good
)

# Community matrix (for PCA)
comm_mat <- as.matrix(
  community_hellinger[, ..community_cols]
) # looks good
comm_mat <- na.omit(comm_mat)
# 2. Run PCA (Hellinger data, CENTERED, not scaled)
pca <- prcomp(comm_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# 3. PCA scores for plotting
scores_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# Base PCA plot
pca_plot_hel <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2,1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2,2], 1), "%)")
  )
# 4. Fit environmental vectors
envfit_res <- envfit(pca, env_df, permutations = 999)

vectors <- scores(envfit_res, display = "vectors")
# 5. Prepare vectors for plotting (arrows scaled to plot)
arrow_scale <- max(abs(scores_df$PC1), abs(scores_df$PC2)) * 0.8

vectors_df <- as.data.frame(vectors * arrow_scale)
vectors_df$env_var <- rownames(vectors_df)
# 6. Add vectors to PCA plot
pca_plot_new <- pca_plot_hel +
  geom_segment(
    data = vectors_df,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = vectors_df,
    aes(x = PC1 * 1.1, y = PC2 * 1.1, label = env_var),
    color = "blue",
    size = 4
  )

print(pca_plot_new)
ggsave("pca_plot_new.png", plot = pca_plot_new, dpi = 300)
browseURL("pca_plot_new.png")

# variance explained
summary(pca)

# Check envfit significance
envfit_res

summary(pca)$importance[2, ]
```

```{r, PCA using Z scores where the axis are env data nd vectors are the community}
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)

# env_df must have x1, x2, x3 columns (numeric)
# comm_mat must be samples x taxa (same row order as env_df)

env_proc <- env_df %>%
  mutate(
    # ---- TRANSFORM RAW DATA ----
    Salinity = log10(Salinity_Avg),     
    Secchi = sqrt(Secchi.depth),      
    Chl = log10(abs(avg_chl_a)),            

    # ---- Z-SCORE NORMALIZATION ----
    Salinity_z = as.numeric(scale(Salinity)),
    Secchi_z = as.numeric(scale(Secchi)),
    Chl_z = as.numeric(scale(Chl)), 
    Temp_z = as.numeric(scale(Water_Temp_Avg))
  )

########  MAKE PCA  ##########
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)

# 1) Build env matrix using Z-scored data
env <- env_proc %>%
  select(Salinity_z, Secchi_z, Chl_z, Temp_z) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 2) Create a row-keep index BEFORE dropping rows
keep_env <- complete.cases(env)

# 3) Subset env and community to the SAME rows
env_use  <- env[keep_env, , drop = FALSE]
comm_use <- comm_mat[keep_env, , drop = FALSE]   # same row order as env_proc

# 4) PCA on env points (already z-scored)
env_pca <- prcomp(env_use, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

scores_df_env <- as.data.frame(env_pca$x)  

# Fit community vectors onto the env PCA scores (comm_mat is already hellinger transformed)
spfit <- envfit(env_pca$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE], comm_mat, permutations = 999)
vec <- scores(spfit, display = "vectors")

spfit <- envfit(env_pca$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE], comm_fit, permutations = 999)
vec <- scores(spfit, display = "vectors")

# Put vectors in a df
vec_df <- as.data.frame(vec)
vec_df$taxon <- rownames(vec_df)
colnames(vec_df)[1:2] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
```

# Convert PCA scores to a data frame
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(community_hellinger$x)
pca_scores$Season <- pca_df$Season

# Calculate explained variance for axis labels
eig <- community_hellinger$sdev^2 / sum(community_hellinger$sdev^2)

# Create PCA plot
pca_4 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Season, shape = Season)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, stroke = 1.1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Winter" = 15, "Spring" = 16, "Summer" = 17, "Fall" = 18)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(eig[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(eig[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    title = "PCA Ram"
  ) +
  # Add horizontal and vertical lines at 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

print(pca_4)
ggsave("pca_plot_4.png", plot = pca_4, dpi = 300)
browseURL("pca_plot_4.png")
